mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_event (slot_id, event_type, slot_version_id, actor_id, body) VALUES (#{slotId}, #{eventType}, #{slotVersionId}, #{actorId}, #{body})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.slot_id, e.event_type, e.slot_version_id, e.actor_id, e.body, e.created_at, a.name AS actor_name, v.version_no FROM activity_event e JOIN account a ON a.id = e.actor_id LEFT JOIN slot_version v ON v.id = e.slot_version_id WHERE e.slot_id = #{slotId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT e.id, e.slot_id, e.event_type, e.slot_version_id, e.actor_id, e.body, e.created_at, a.name AS actor_name, v.version_no, s.slot_type FROM activity_event e JOIN account a ON a.id = e.actor_id JOIN deliverable_slot s ON s.id = e.slot_id LEFT JOIN slot_version v ON v.id = e.slot_version_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
